scope: Primary-format and current peer research to refine generated test gates, DWG version scope, and independent-kernel qualification. Plan update only; no source/test execution or external installation in this pass.

primaryDocuments.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, Version 5.4.1

method.evidenceRule: Format documents constrain byte-level claims; peer declarations, open reports, generated self-roundtrips, and commercial product matrices are leads/capability statements, not local interoperability or support qualification.

findings.evidence: The local v5.4.1 PDF has an explicit R2018 organization chapter: R2018 is described as structurally identical to R2013, with summarized deltas including three zero shorts at the end of AuxHeader and selected entity/object changes. Chapter 24's DataStorage introduction retains a December 2012 knowledge caveat, while §20.4.41 says the ACIS entity stream is not completely decrypted; §24 specifies the container but says detailed ACIS/SAB bytes are outside its scope.
findings.planEffect: Use ODA v5.4.1 R2018 text for only its stated structural/version deltas. Do not infer complete AC1032 AcDs schema, profile behavior, or ACIS semantics from structural similarity; record the actual sample's revision, segment kinds, and payload markers.

findings.evidence: ODA §24.2.2.3 states data records hold byte arrays up to 0x40000 bytes; larger values use a blob reference to one or more blob01 segments, with maximum page payload 0xfffb0. Blob descriptors carry total length, page count, nominal/last-page lengths and page segment indices; each page carries total length, page-start offset, zero-based page index/count and data length. Data index entries join a data segment/local offset to a schema index; data record headers include the owning handle. §24.2.2.7 says the search segment may be ignored when reading, but §24.2.2.7.1 says AutoCAD ignores a stored entity if the required search-index object/handle mapping is absent.
findings.localAudit: src/drw_datastorage.cpp already validates and optionally assembles referenced pages under a retention cap. tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp::testDataStorageBounds currently covers inline schema properties, but the test tree has no generated blob-reference/blob01-chain control.
findings.planEffect: Before expanding AcDs writing, add in-memory segment/data-index/blob-page vectors for the 0x40000 transition, ordered multi-page reconstruction, all index/length joins, and atomic malformed-page rejection. Preserve the read/write asymmetry: a reader may not need the search segment for payload extraction, but a writer claiming AutoCAD-visible output must emit its required searchable object mapping.

findings.evidence: Autodesk's DXF polyface reference says header group 71/72 counts need not be correct and readers should tolerate noncanonical vertex/face ordering; writers should emit all coordinate vertices before face records. VERTEX group 71-74 are signed 1-based indexes, a negative index marks the edge beginning at that corner invisible, zero terminates the face, and the supported face record is limited to four indices.
findings.localAudit: The in-tree generated coverage already checks caller-side interleaved input, canonical writer order, signed visibility values, and a following record. It does not expose a dedicated read control where declared counts disagree with child records or face records precede coordinate records.
findings.planEffect: Add focused ASCII/binary read controls for inaccurate header counts, face-first/interleaved child order, signed edge visibility and legal/invalid indices. Keep output canonical (vertices before faces) and reject malformed references without consuming the following parent/entity boundary.

findings.evidence: ezdxf describes ACIS browsing as carrier inspection and its renderer does not support ACIS or general 3D rendering. Open Cascade lists ACIS-SAT among separate commercial data-exchange components rather than the public open-source core. The Ansys ACIS interface documents standalone SAT/SAB solid/surface/line-body reading on Windows/Linux but requires an entitled installation. CAD Exchanger has distinct licensed format components and platform/architecture configurations. Existing cq-acis notes identify a separately implemented parser but an OCCT geometry backend shared with FreeCAD.
findings.planEffect: Preflight reader, kernel, and application lineage independently. A separately implemented parser using OCCT can be a parser cross-check, not an independent-kernel result; a vendor capability table cannot qualify the exact ASM/SAB profile. Pin product/release/platform/license mode and observed inner SAT/SAB version, then compare against source-native dimensions and a distinct kernel lineage before semantic promotion.

readyGeneratedControls: Direct records at 0x3ffff and 0x40000 bytes; blob-reference case at 0x40001 bytes with exact concatenated output.
Multi-page blob with deliberately nonmonotonic segment indexes but ascending zero-based page indexes; assert total length, each page start, page lengths, and byte-for-byte payload reconstruction.

Malformed variants: wrong page index/count/start offset/segment kind, missing page, inconsistent last-page size, arithmetic overflow, out-of-range segment, and truncated descriptor/data; require structural rejection, no partial payload publication, and next-record containment.
Polyface reader variants with inaccurate 71/72 counts and unusual child ordering; preserve signed visibility and 1-based index identity, while writer output stays canonical.
R2018/DataStorage comparisons must report section revision and marker/profile observations separately from ODA's R2013 structural-equivalence summary.
implementationOrder: Keep the MESH override slice committed and pass its fast gate.
Complete f.3c VisualStyle descriptor/model alignment without admitting a serializer.
Add the DataStorage blob/page parser controls against the existing implementation before opening any ACDS writer profile.
Add missing polyface reader-tolerance controls, preserving the existing canonical writer contract.
Continue route/version-specific container transfer; require a complete search-index/object/handle graph for output acceptance.
Run the separately pinned native/kernel qualification only after source-native known dimensions and reader/kernel lineage are available.
